name: project tile
script:
# Get the customer name
customer_name = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "customer_name") if doc.customer else ""

# Generate the new project_name
if customer_name:
    new_name = f"{doc.name.split('-')[-1]} - {customer_name}"
    frappe.db.set_value("Project", doc.name, "project_name", new_name)
